commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 3 - 0 Samson Baidoo (Lens) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns the resulting corner into his own net.
89' It will be a corner kick for Lens.
85' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Laurent Abergel (Lorient), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' Substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dermane Karim walks off.
82' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Wesley Said will be replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
82' Substitution. Ruben Aguilar is replaced by Saud Abdulhamid (Lens).
81' Wonderful movement by Lorient. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
77' 2 - 0 Wesley Said (Lens) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
76' A pass from Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is intercepted by Robin Risser and the move breaks down.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) for Theo Le Bris.
75' Substitution. Aiyegun Tosin makes his way off the pitch and Sambou Soumano (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
71' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) replacing Florian Thauvin.
71' The substitution has been made. Rayan Fofana (Lens) has replaced Odsonne Edouard.
71' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremie Pignard saw the whole situation. Lens have a free kick.
69' Great teamplay by Lorient as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
68' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) will take the corner.
67' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
65' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Arthur Avom is replaced by Noah Cadiou (Lorient).
65' Substitution. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) on for Mohamed Bamba.
64' That was a poorly executed penalty. Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) couldn't beat the goalkeeper with that shot.
64' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
62' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) gets a yellow card.

62' Poor challenge! Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is penalised for tripping and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Lorient is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
61' Lorient have a corner.

61' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Robin Risser anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Lorient force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' That's the end of the game for Mamadou Sangare, who is replaced by Andrija Bulatovic (Lens).
58' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
55' The ball goes out for a corner. Lorient can continue in their attacking effort.
55' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Mohamed Bamba (Lorient)! That was a huge opportunity!

55' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Robin Risser has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
53' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) steps up to send the ball in.

50' Golden chance! Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
48' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' The referee points to the corner flag and Lens will take a corner.
42' Florian Thauvin (Lens) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.

40' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle as Odsonne Edouard (Lens) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Lorient, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
39' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
38' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
36' A neat pass is well received by Mamadou Sangare (Lens), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
35' The referee blows his whistle, Lorient are awarded a corner kick.
34' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
33' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Lorient earn a corner.
32' 6:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
29' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Risser punches the ball away.
26' Today's referee Jeremie Pignard rightly decides to book Arthur Avom (Lorient) for his harsh tackle.
24' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
24' Matthieu Udol (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lens get a corner.
22' Matthieu Udol (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lorient are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
18' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a throw-in.
13' Florian Thauvin (Lens) will take a corner kick.
11' Corner kick. Florian Thauvin (Lens) is ready to send the ball into the box.
11' Matthieu Udol (Lens) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
9' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
6' Lens will take a corner kick.
3' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
2' Lorient seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lorient will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard will referee today's match.
